notes:
Account summary: working procurement for enterprise reserved capacity + formal SLA. Decision committee: CTO (Anika Rao), Head of Ops (Tom Liu), Security (Renee Park).

Key business drivers:
- Replace current vendor (3x token cost, variable latency) — cost + predictability are top priorities.
- Financial services regulatory needs: data residency + audit trail non-negotiable.
- High sensitivity to incident MTTR; fraud use-case requires automated failover and clear credit schedule.

SLA / technical requirements (notes from 2025-03-11 call):
- Uptime target: 99.99% monthly for dedicated pool (NorthStar insists on four nines).
- Credits: tiered credit schedule requested: <99.99 and >=99.95 => 5% monthly credit; <99.95 and >=99.9 => 12% credit; <99.9 => 25% credit OR termination right after two consecutive months (legal to confirm).
- Maintenance windows: prefer Sundays 02:00-05:00 PT; critical windows must be notified 30 days prior; emergency maintenance permitted but must be limited and credited.
- Support SLAs: P1 (total outage) 1-hour response, 4-hour remediation targets; P2 degraded performance 2-hour response, 12-hour remediation target. Need dedicated escalation path and a named TAM.
- Latency SLOs: p95 inference latency <= 120ms for chat endpoints at steady-state; p99 < 300ms except during rare bursts.
- Throughput guarantees: baseline 2000 rps sustained for their primary cluster (peak 6k rps burst capacity). Reserved GPU planning: initial commit for 8x A100-equivalent nodes with hot-standby capacity for 1 node; autoscale bursts 2x for 4 hours/day.
- Routing/fallback: must support deterministic fallback to a quantized model variant with documented quality delta; acceptance tests to verify fallbacks.
- Observability: token-level billing breakdown, per-route latency and error dashboards, request tracing for 90 days.

- 2025-03-04: Intro call (Maya + Diego). Fireflies: ff_20250304_intro.

- Achieve p95 latency <=120ms under 2k rps sustained for 30m during load test.
- Failover within 30s to quantized model without >2% degradation in reranking accuracy measured on their holdout prompts.
- Demonstrate observability + audit log export to their SIEM.
